We pride ourselves on having something for everyone, with a huge range of wine available hailing from premium Victorian producers, Australian suppliers and imported overseas drops. We wouldn't be your local without a huge range of beer on tap either.

Ask our team for today’s glass and bottle prices, or see the wine list.

Our kitchens use a wide range of ingredients, and while we take care with every dish, traces of allergens (such as nuts, seafood, shellfish, gluten, sesame, wheat, eggs, fungi, and dairy) may be present. We can't guarantee any menu item is completely free from cross contamination. If you have any food allergies or dietary requirements, please let our team know before ordering so we can provide information to help you make an informed choice.

Eat and drink

Whatever you’re in the mood for, we’ve got something for everyone

A meeting place in Melbourne’s north. Whether it is an overdue family lunch, a beer with colleagues or a glass raised to a milestone, there is a corner of the hotel for it.

The Family Bistro

Our Family Bistro is a key dining spot for Melbourne’s north, featuring delicious food made by our experienced and passionate team. You’ll have your choice of succulent steaks, fresh seafood, wholesome pastas, classic well-loved pub favourites plus much more.

Take a seat in our spacious dining area inside or soak up the rays in our outdoor seating area. Whether it’s a family reunion, an overdue catch up with mates or an intimate date, our Family Bistro is the perfect place to meet.

Our Bistro is open every day from 11:30 am, so book a table online or head in and visit our friendly team.

Book a tableSee the menu

The Sports Bar

When you walk into our Sports Bar, you’ll feel instantly at home. Our welcoming team behind the bar are happy to recommend one of our many ice cold beers on tap, or something from our wine, cider or spirits list.

The Pascoe Vale Hotel is the ultimate sports lover’s dream. We have multiple large screens for you to catch all the action, with Foxtel and Sky Channel broadcasting live.

You’ll be covered with full TAB betting facilities available, not to mention your favourite pub meals available to order over the counter.

Whether it’s a drink on your way home from work, a catch up with mates over a brew or raising a glass when your team scores, we have something for everyone.

The Beer Garden

If the sun is shining, stop into our Beer Garden, the perfect place to sink a brew and relax with mates. We have large projector screens and various TV screens we use to catch all the big games.

The bottleshop sits outside, and there is parking on site, so it is easy to pull in on the way home.

Your ultimate UFC pub

We’re dedicated to showing every bout loud, free and on the big screen. Immerse yourself in the excitement at your home of UFC. Grab your mates or make some new ones while you watch all the action unfold.

And there is a band in the bar every Sunday, so the weekend does not end when the fight does.

Functions and events

Ten to one hundred guests

The Pascoe Vale Hotel is a versatile function and event space. We specialise in private and corporate events, everything from conferences to birthdays, engagements and wakes. We’re able to tailor our rooms and event experiences to what you need, with cocktail, conferencing or seated menus.

The Vale

Our private function room, The Vale, can cater for private events such as corporate meetings, private dinners and cocktail parties.

With plenty of natural light, A/V facilities, free wifi, iPod connectivity, on-site parking and flexible catering options, we are equipped to make your next event a success. We understand that every event is different and we will work with you to ensure yours is one to remember.
